# PE Header Extraction

Extracts and analyzes Portable Executable (PE) headers from Windows binaries.

## Usage
- Parses DOS, COFF, and Optional headers from PE files
- Lists imported DLLs, exported functions, and section tables
- Detects anomalies such as packed sections or suspicious imports
- Outputs structured analysis for malware triage and reverse engineering
